population.description: Generally healthy adults without elevated triglycerides or established cardiovascular disease, at typical supplement doses

gradeRationale.note: This is the claim the general-wellness eligibility rule actually cites - grade Limited, so the outcome is 'potentially useful', never 'recommended'. Pairing it with the Strong triglyceride claim in the same file is the guard against grade laundering.

statement: For generally healthy adults without elevated triglycerides, evidence that low-dose EPA/DHA supplements reduce cardiovascular events is mixed and largely null in the major trials; benefit is more clearly associated with regular oily-fish consumption than with supplementation.
